# SMA Healthcare

> > SMA Healthcare (Stewart Marchman Act Behavioral Healthcare) provides comprehensive behavioral health, crisis intervention, and addiction recovery services across multiple Florida counties including Volusia, St. Johns, Marion, Putnam, Flagler, and Citrus.

SMA Healthcare operates crisis stabilization units, including a specialized Children's CSU, and offers programs like the BEACH House Program, WARM Program, and Volusia Rape Crisis Center. The organization works under Florida's Baker Act and Marchman Act frameworks, supported by the SMA Healthcare Foundation and community partnerships including the University of Florida and Orlando Magic Youth Foundation.
